name: WebSockets and SSE Security
source: WebSockets and SSE Security/WebSockets and SSE Security - Interview Questions & Answers.md

prompts.title: Cookie auth on WebSockets—safe?
prompts.answerMarkdown: **A:** Only with **Origin validation** + **SameSite** + **channel ACLs**-prefer **token in first message** or subprotocol with caveats.

prompts.title: WebSocket vs SSE security?
prompts.answerMarkdown: **A:** Both need **auth at handshake**; SSE often uses cookies → CSWSH/CORS issues; WebSocket adds **bidirectional abuse** (client flood).

prompts.title: How authorize pub/sub channels?
prompts.answerMarkdown:
**A:** Map connection to **principal/tenant from token**; never trust client-supplied tenant ID alone.
